text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the school, I
happen upon
a group of students
gathered around a
noticeboard...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Check out my very own feng shui
newspaper! Go
on and grab a copy! It's a
must-read!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! I know, right? I wanted to
spread
the word about feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I've just been borrowing
empty
classrooms to teach feng shui
classes.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I never got too many students, though...
And
maybe people just don't know
about feng shui in
the first place...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Anyway! That's why I thought I should
raise
awareness about feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And to do that, I need to put it right
where
everyone can see it. So I put up a
newspaper on
the noticeboard! What do
you think? Great idea,
huh? ☆

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, so how do we check our
horoscope? Do we
need our star sign or
blood type or whatever?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Actually, this is different! It's called
Nine-Star Qi,
and it works by taking the
year and month you
were born, then—

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait. "Nine Star"? So like, these
aren't
horoscopes?

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
This stuff sounds really niche. I'm pretty
sure it'll
go over my head...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about that! There are some
aspects
of feng shui you can put into
practice right
away—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! What's the meaning of this
commotion?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I should have known. At it again, are you
Rickey?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
H-hold on a second! I just want to
support
everyone so they can all give
100%!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I told you not to post anything on the noticeboard without permission! I'll be confiscating those newspapers! Next time, go through the proper channels!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Well, that didn't work out...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I mean, getting permission is one thing,
but... it
sounded like those girls were
intimidated by the
whole idea...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Geez. I made feng shui sound confusing
again.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That's it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly it! Everyone just needs to
get more
familiar with feng shui!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If they see it every day, it'll become part
of their
daily lives... Okay, if I stick to it,
I can make this
happen!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Trainer! I got my spark back!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But what's the angle? I should probably
share
some more detailed information
before putting a
newspaper up on the
noticeboard...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Social media! Wow, that's a fantastic
idea! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Jordaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You, like, surprised me. ...What is
it? You
here to tell me my lucky color or
something?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And I'm going to start posting
about that
stuff on social media every
day too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Can you tell me how to get everyone to
look at
my posts?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, "everyone" as in, like, putting the info out for the whole world to see? I can get behind that! Okay, so first, you've really gotta nail the look...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, Copano Rickey posts a few nail
photos
along with some feng shui advice.
Apparently, her
posts get a decent
number of views.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Relevant experience? Oh, I think I know
someone
who fits the bill!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, okay. ☆ Well, if you're talking
about
making a connection with each of
your fans, then
you've come to the right
person!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's get started right away! It's time for
Rickey
the feng shui Umadol to shine!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! Did you say "Umadol"?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If you sing with a smile every single day,
you'll
have a huge audience in no
time. ☆ Just do some
feng shui while you
sing! That'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
O...kay?! That could be pretty
entertaining!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Copano Rickey has started
down a
completely new path... but I
want to keep
supporting her efforts all
the same.
